name: Goldener Engl
beschreibung:
Located in the heart of western Austria's largest historic old town, Goldener Engl welcomes visitors within centuries-old walls. Elegant rooms and an exquisite restaurant ensure an unforgettable stay.

Hasegg Castle with its Mint Tower, the historic town square, and Innsbruck are only minutes away.
kurzbeschreibung: The historic Schlosshotel Goldener Engl in Hall in Tirol blends heritage charm with contemporary hotel comfort.
